title: Markisol
description: markisol.se zoominfo.com/c/markisol-ab/357807356 Markisol Group is a Swedish family-owned manufacturer of window blinds (roller, venetian, pleated, roman, and panel) headquartered in Ronneby, Sweden, founded in the late 1960s by Bo Persson, who started making blinds at age 6 alongside his father and built the company into one of the world's leading blind producers. The company has been a supplier to IKEA since 1983 and is fully vertically integrated — it designs and builds its own patented assembly machines (up to 400 blinds per hour), produces its own components, and weaves and prints its own fabrics at its textile plant in Narva, Estonia (in the historic Krenholm factory).
